title: Business plan
brief: A complete, beautifully typeset business plan for 'Maison Ryokū' — a fictional Paris specialty-matcha house opening 3 locations in 24 months: concept and positioning, market with sourced real figures (matcha boom, 2025–26 tencha shortage, Paris café economics), competition, per-location unit economics, a 24-month quarterly P&L and monthly cash plan as ruled tables, staffing, marketing, risks, a EUR 600k funding ask with use of funds, milestones, and scenario/sensitivity analysis — all numbers tying arithmetically.
da: Warm editorial print — cream paper, deep matcha green and charcoal, Cormorant Garamond display over a humanist sans, drop caps, pull-quotes, ruled financial tables, hand-drawn chawan linework.
